meta.name: OpenAPI endpoints
meta.about: Every endpoint HAXcms promises: 151 operations in 20 areas, generated from site-spec.yaml and system-spec.yaml. Both backends implement them; the MCP and the CLI call them. Tiles are colored by HTTP method.

op_getsiteapidiscovery.desc: Get API capabilities and discovery links

op_updatesitesummary.desc: Update site summary and manifest-level metadata

op_updatesitealternativeformats.desc: Regenerate alternative output formats for the current site

op_checksitelinks.desc: Checks up to 25 outside http(s) links per request. Only links that appear in this site's own page HTML are fetched; any other link is answered with state "skipped" and reason "not-in-site". Each link is requested server side with HEAD (GET when HEAD is refused) through the SSRF guard: private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are never contacted, the body is never read and only the status and final URL come back. Answers are cached for a while, and network checks are limited per user and site (config.security.linkCheckRateLimit); cached answers do not count against the limit.

op_updatesiteseo.desc: Update site SEO and author settings

op_updatesiteoutline.desc: Update site outline structure as a single atomic operation

op_normalizesiteslugs.desc: Normalize all site page slugs based on current titles and pathauto settings

op_downloaditemexport.desc: Text formats are public for items visible to anonymous visitors. The pdf and docx formats are rendered per request and require authentication; anonymous requests receive 401.

op_listentitydescriptors.desc: Returns the full merged set of entity descriptors sourced from the single entities.yaml registry (EntityRegistry getDefinitions()). Both /x/api/v1/entities and /system/api/v1/entities read from the same registry, so the API surface and the in-code object are one shape. Optional ?scope=site|system filters the merged set by scope. Each descriptor mirrors the extended EntityDescriptor schema, including the storage block that declares how the entity is (or will be) persisted.

op_listschemas.desc: List schema descriptors and JSON schema fragments

op_listitems.desc: Anonymous requests only return published items that are not hidden from navigation.

op_createitem.desc: Create a new item in the outline

op_getsiteexport.desc: The md format returns the whole site as one markdown document in outline order (also served as llms-full.txt), with an ETag for conditional requests. Anonymous callers may request the md and html formats (unpublished and hidden pages are excluded). The pdf, docx and epub formats render the whole site per request and require authentication; anonymous requests receive 401.

op_createsiteexport.desc: Get a site export descriptor for a format (metadata only, no binary download)

op_getitembyidorslug.desc: Anonymous requests only return items that are published and not hidden from navigation.

op_updateitem.desc: Update an item using outline and page detail operations

op_deleteitem.desc: Delete an item by id or slug

op_listitemrevisions.desc: List git-backed revision history for one item

op_getitemrevisionbyid.desc: Get one item revision payload by git hash

op_compareitemrevisions.desc: Returns the page content at both revisions and the page detail fields (title, description, slug, published, hideInMenu, locked, from the .json variant) that differ. "from" is revisionId and "to" is compareRevisionId; either order works.

op_restoreitemrevision.desc: Restore one item revision as a new commit

op_listcontent.desc: Anonymous requests only return content for published items that are not hidden from navigation.

op_replacecontent.desc: Replace text across site content in a single operation

op_getcontentbyidorslug.desc: Anonymous requests only return content for items that are published and not hidden from navigation.

op_updatecontentbyidorslug.desc: Update one item content payload by id or slug

op_listfiles.desc: Returns the site file collection sourced from the per-site files.json datastore (HAXCMS-FILE-SCHEMA-V1). Before returning, auto-indexes any on-disk files missing from the index so manually-dropped files appear with no separate reconcile endpoint. Also flags orphan records (whose disk file is gone) into a non-destructive 'orphans' array on the response; files.json is NOT mutated for orphans.

op_createfile.desc: Upload a file to the site files directory

op_getfilebyuuid.desc: Get one file record by UUID

op_updatefilebyuuid.desc: Supported operation values: rename, convert-jpg, scale, sepia, black-and-white, rotate-90, compress, duplicate. Use the DELETE method for the delete operation instead.

op_searchcontent.desc: Anonymous requests only search published items that are not hidden from navigation. Send a bearer token to also search unpublished and hidden items (logged-in editors).

op_listcustomelements.desc: List custom element descriptors from registry

op_listblocks.desc: List block records and usage counts

op_getblockbyname.desc: Get one block record by custom element name

op_getregionbyname.desc: Get one region and member item records

op_getthemebyname.desc: Get one theme by machine name

op_getviewresults.desc: Resolve and return results for a view

op_getblockusage.desc: List pages where the block is used

op_sessionauthpost.desc: Anonymous login probe. Returns session details when a valid JWT is supplied (body or query) and a minimal unauthenticated response otherwise. No bearer auth is required to reach this endpoint.

op_generateappstore.desc: Generate app-store provider manifest for the editor

op_searchappstoreprovider.desc: Proxies a search request to a registered app-store provider (e.g. product-card, media, etc.) and returns the provider's response payload. Moved to the system API in D38; documented here per D57. Requires a valid bearer JWT and site token so only authenticated site contexts can broker upstream provider searches.

op_haxiamadduseraccess.desc: PHP-only route exposed by HAXiam-managed deployments to add user access to a site. Documented here per D57 for cross-platform spec parity; NodeJS deployments that do not run HAXiam will return 404.

op_systementitiesget.desc: Returns the full merged set of entity descriptors sourced from the single entities.yaml registry (EntityRegistry getDefinitions()). Both /x/api/v1/entities and /system/api/v1/entities read from the same registry, so the API surface and the in-code object are one shape. Optional ?scope=site|system filters the merged set by scope. Each descriptor mirrors the extended EntityDescriptor schema, including the storage block that declares how the entity is (or will be) persisted.

op_getapikeys.desc: Returns all configured system API keys and provider connection statuses. security (F3/authz): this endpoint exposes system-wide credentials and is restricted to the superUser (admin) principal on the PHP backend (see SystemRoutesMap::getSystemV1SuperUserReadRoutes and the handler defense-in-depth superUser check); a non-superUser authenticated caller receives 403. The NodeJS single-user backend does not model an admin tier and allows the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_getapikeyspost.desc: Read-only alias of GET /configuration/api-keys. POST is accepted for callers that prefer POST over GET but does not write; use PATCH to update API key settings. security (F3/authz): like the GET, this endpoint exposes system-wide credentials and is restricted to the superUser (admin) principal on the PHP backend; a non-superUser authenticated caller receives 403. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; these settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_saveapikeyspatch.desc: Write operation — updates API key settings. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_getmediasettingspost.desc: Read-only alias of GET /configuration/media. POST is accepted for callers that prefer POST over GET but does not write; use PATCH to update media settings. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; these settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_savemediasettingspatch.desc: Write operation — updates media and upload configuration. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_getlocalizationsettings.desc: Return localization and system default configuration

op_getlocalizationsettingspost.desc: Read-only alias of GET /configuration/localization. POST is accepted for callers that prefer POST over GET but does not write; use PATCH to update localization settings. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; these settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_savelocalizationsettingspatch.desc: Write operation — updates the system-wide default language (and future localization defaults). The persisted value seeds the default language applied to newly created sites and is editable post-install via the Configuration admin panel. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_schemafileoperation.desc: Write operation — performs schema file operations (rename, delete, upload) in system configuration storage. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; operations are performed by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_systemblockspost.desc: Read-only alias of GET /blocks. POST is accepted for callers that prefer POST over GET but does not write; use PATCH to update enabled block configuration. op_saveenabledblockspatch.desc: Write operation — updates enabled block configuration. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_systemskeletonspost.desc: Read-only alias of GET /skeletons. POST is accepted for callers that prefer POST over GET but does not write; use PATCH to update enabled skeleton configuration. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; these settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_saveenabledskeletonspatch.desc: Write operation — updates enabled skeleton configuration. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

op_systemskeletondetailget.desc: Return details for a named skeleton

op_systemskeletondetailput.desc: Rename a named skeleton (compatibility alias for PATCH)

op_systemlanguagesget.desc:
The canonical language registry (the same languages.json the installer,
settings screens and CLI use). `regions` controls which regional
variants (en-GB, pt-BR...) are included.

op_systemlanguageget.desc:
Accepts a canonical code or an alias / underscore form (zh_CN, iw).
The returned `code` is always canonical.

op_systemlanguagetranslationsget.desc:
Every translated string for the language, grouped by element
namespace (for translators, review tooling and LLMs). A full language
is several hundred KB; use `namespace` to fetch a single element.

op_saveenabledthemespatch.desc: Write operation — updates enabled theme configuration. Single-user deployment assumption: the NodeJS backend does not model an admin/superUser tier; settings are written by the single authenticated dashboard user.

scenes.caption: HAXcms is built on one OpenAPI contract.
Two spec files: one for a site, one for the system.
The site spec: pages, content, files, themes, search, reports.
The system spec: sessions, lifecycle, settings and actions.
Every one of the 151 operations. Select any for its summary.
